workflows.name: Relationship creation and directional inspection
steps: inspect permitted relationship context
create one directional edge with explicit type/profile bindings
inspect edge/dimensions in graph, tree and semantic linear views
guards: never auto-create reciprocal B→A edge
no universal relationship score or scale
hidden endpoint existence and fields filtered before topology, counts, labels or autocomplete
authoritative create uses P10-MUT-001 expected_version/operation_id recovery
keyboard edge form
ordered source→target semantic summary

workflows.name: Relationship dimension change, reveal and history
steps: inspect current edge/history
change one explicit relationship dimension with attributable cause Event
reveal or revoke selected fields
review retained role-safe history
guards: reveal never mutates hidden cause into Player knowledge automatically
profile examples never become universal thresholds
reveal filtering precedes history derivatives and graph updates
lost response checks operation status/current version before retry
revocation purges protected projections before role-safe rebuild
keyboard dimension/reveal controls
screen-reader old/new value and reveal-state history

workflows.name: Bond, obligation and leverage authoring
steps: inspect relationship context
create or update Bond/obligation/leverage instrument
record terms/source references and visibility
review history without collapsing instrument into relationship dimension
guards: five source Bond names remain examples/profile material
obligation cannot silently transfer Project/Contract ownership
protected terms and source references filtered before summary/AI context
instrument writes use governed mutation protocol and stable operation id
structured terms list
nonvisual endpoint/profile/source summary

workflows.name: Social Mode setup and truth/belief context
steps: inspect social interaction and role-safe truth/belief state
start or update Social Mode with mode, participants, audience, objective and stakes
retain truth/belief/claim separation
workflows.owner: MV-IA-F010 Social Interaction Mode plus PPIA-08 placement
guards: Social Mode cannot rewrite Campaign/Scene lifecycle
Deception/Persuasion context cannot auto-adjudicate truth
objective truth and private belief remain filtered before conversation summaries and AI context
interaction updates use expected_version/operation_id and current-version recovery
keyboard participant/objective editor
screen-reader distinction among truth, belief, claim and secret

workflows.name: Social action proposal, GM review and accepted generated proposal
steps: propose social action with intent/evidence/terms
GM accepts, rejects or modifies under explicit authority
if generated material is used, explicitly accept only the selected diff
retain decision receipt
guards: silence is never approval
AI has no irreversible social/faction authority
hidden evidence/targets excluded before proposal generation or review
proposal/review/accept writes are idempotent and version checked
keyboard proposal and decision controls
plain-language accepted/rejected/modified terms summary

workflows.name: Atomic social resolution, temporary state and compensation
steps: inspect accepted proposal and role-safe context
resolve through owning mechanics without inventing universal DC
commit all persistent consequences as one Event group or none
record bounded temporary mood/intent/stance if applicable
use compensating Event group for reversible correction
workflows.owner: MV-IA-F010 orchestration plus owning consequence domains
guards: no universal social DC or mind-control result
temporary mood/intent/stance never silently becomes persistent relationship/standing
protected outcome drafts filtered before review, event emission and history projection
cross-domain commit is atomic
ambiguous result uses operation-status/current-version lookup
compensation appends history rather than deleting it
ordered result/event history
nonvisual degree/outcome/temporary-state summary
